name: mrz-paste-input
title: MRZ Paste Input
description: Stops misread passport details reaching a booking or KYC form by validating a pasted or typed passport MRZ (ICAO 9303 TD3) check digit by check digit, catching OCR slips like O for 0 and K for <, swapped lines, CRLF and stray spaces, proposing the likeliest fix for a wrong check digit (cross-checked against the composite digit) and flagging an expired or soon-expiring passport, then filling in name, number, nationality, dates and sex.
